hero.titleSuffix: , from the classroom to the field of giving
hero.description: An association bringing together the alumni of Al Mourabitine High School to preserve the bonds of brotherhood, give back to our school, and support the coming generations of students.

about.title: The story of a generation giving back
about.p1: The Al Mourabitine High School Alumni Association was founded out of a genuine desire by a group of graduates to preserve the bond that once united them at school, and to turn it into real community work serving the school and the local community.
about.p2: We believe education is a bridge built generation after generation. That is why we work to bring alumni together, create spaces for connection and cooperation, and support current students with the experience and knowledge our alumni have gained.

pillars.title: Connection
pillars.desc: Bringing together alumni of the school across different generations and graduating classes.

pillars.title: Support
pillars.desc: Supporting current students academically and socially whenever possible.

pillars.desc: Organizing meetings and workshops that benefit both alumni and students.

pillars.title: Volunteering
pillars.desc: Engaging in solidarity initiatives that serve the school and its surrounding neighborhood.

activities.title: What we do on the ground

fallback.title: Annual Alumni Gathering

fallback.desc: An initiative to support current students through guidance sessions and help with core subjects.

fallback.title: Support for Students in Need
fallback.desc: Contributions and in-kind donations to provide school tools and supplies when needed.

fallback.title: Volunteer Initiatives
fallback.desc: Awareness and volunteer campaigns within the school and the neighborhood, with the participation of alumni and students.
